dimensions.name: BLOCKING FIX IS REAL (run_evolve.sh + launchd wiring)

Confirmed the old `command -v openevolve-run.py` / `openevolve-run.py \` invocation strings are GONE (grep for both returns nothing).
Confirmed the venv only contains the real binary: `ls ~/.anicca-venvs/self-improve/bin | grep -i openevolve` -> only `openevolve-run` (no `.py` variant exists anywhere).

LOUD-FAIL test (mine): `cd skills/earn/self-improve && OPENEVOLVE_BIN=/nonexistent/x bash run_evolve.sh` -> stderr `FATAL: openevolve-run not found or not executable at /nonexistent/x` + install hint, exit code 1 (confirmed via `echo $?`). No silent exit 0.

MINIMAL-PATH real-invocation test (mine): `timeout 90 env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH=/usr/bin:/bin SELF_IMPROVE_ITERATIONS=2 bash run_evolve.sh` (PATH stripped to just /usr/bin:/bin, no venv/homebrew/project dirs — simulates launchd's minimal env) -> exit 0. Log shows REAL openevolve startup, not a skip: 'Initialized OpenAI LLM with model: free/mistral-large-3-675b', 'Initialized LLM ensemble with models: free/mistral-large-3-675b (weight: 0.33) x3', 'Loaded database with 23 programs from runs/db', real per-iteration timings (32.08s, 18.13s — consistent with real LLM round-trips), 'New MAP-Elites cell occupied', and a real completion: 'Evolution complete! Best program metrics: combined_score: 9.4486, stage1_pass: 1.0000' with a best_program.py/best_program_info.json actually written to the new run dir. This is unambiguous proof the script reaches and runs the real binary under a minimal, launchd-like PATH — not a 'not installed -> skip' branch.

launchd/ai.anicca.self-improve-evolve.plist: confirmed WorkingDirectory=/Users/operator/anicca/skills/earn/self-improve and EnvironmentVariables.PATH=/Users/operator/.anicca-venvs/self-improve/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin (+HOME). `plutil -lint` on the plist returns OK.

summary: Iteration-1's single blocking finding (run_evolve.sh invoking a non-existent `openevolve-run.py`, silently no-oping the REQ-OE7 zero-human recurring trigger) is genuinely and completely resolved. Verified myself, not by trusting claims: (1) the script now references the real binary `openevolve-run` (no `.py`) by an absolute, durable, non-scratchpad venv path (`$HOME/.anicca-venvs/self-improve/bin/openevolve-run`), with no PATH/`command -v` dependency; (2) a deliberately-broken `OPENEVOLVE_BIN=/nonexistent/x` run now fails LOUD (`FATAL: openevolve-run not found...`, exit 1) instead of silently exiting 0; (3) an `env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` run (simulating launchd's minimal environment) actually reached and ran REAL openevolve — real LLM-ensemble init, real per-iteration timings, a real completed evolution run with a written best_program.py — proving this is not decorative; (4) the launchd plist now carries WorkingDirectory + an explicit PATH (venv bin first) and passes `plutil -lint`. No regression: the 18/18 test suite is still green, and 3 of my own freshly-constructed adversarial probes (fixed-region tamper, denylisted-import tamper, legit edit) confirm scope_guard.py remains real, fail-closed, and the sole enforcement mechanism. No new holes: no secrets in the plist/script/config, the durable venv is outside the repo (not committed), and the CWD fix correctly pins db_path writes under the skill dir regardless of invoking CWD. One pre-existing (not introduced by this fix) hygiene issue was found and disclosed: 99 raw run-evidence files (~2.6MB, from the prior commit cf935f0, before this fix) remain tracked in git even though a new .gitignore now correctly excludes future run output — no secrets found in them, non-blocking, flagged for a follow-up `git rm --cached`. Honesty is maintained: execution-notes still explicitly frames the +9.4486 candidate as variance-amplification/leverage on identical trade selection, not a validated strategy, and confirms the REQ-RH4 per-candidate promotion adversary has correctly not been invoked. All iteration-1 PASSes (beats-baseline reproducibility, scope_guard reality, no-live-money) were independently re-confirmed with identical numbers. Overall verdict: PASS.
